comment: C-only source-corrected first-prayer candidate. u_init.c initializes u.ublesscnt to 300, so the previous fresh prayer was too soon. This recipe gives the hero 350 turns of wizard invulnerability, reaches experience level 12 while acknowledging each C-observed More page, waits 300 turns with safe_wait disabled, then prays for the first time at a neutral shrine. Its source target is pray.c:prayer_done -> pleased/prayer_success and the spell-gift case; all input choices are driven by C screens and source preconditions, not JavaScript.
